actions.title: Yield to GovDAO
actions.description: The governor's one-way hand-over (ADR pr6375 §7.7): from this block only GovDAO proposals decide and Govern is closed for good. Queued decisions still apply by Execute.
pitfalls: Irreversible. After it, every action marked governor needs a GovDAO proposal with 2 of the 3 T1 members voting YES.
Before yielding, check that GovDAO can actually reach supermajority (memberstore: 3 T1 members, 2 YES votes needed).

actions.title: Govern (governor's direct decision)
actions.description: Before the yield the governor makes any builder's decision directly, in its own m_run, through the same closure GovDAO runs after the yield (same checks, at-once test, 7-day queue and record). Refused for every other caller, and for everyone after the yield.

params.name: EXPR
params.validation: an ibcgov builder call from this catalog.

timing.notes: Records the decision in the same tx: applied, queued (due = now + delay) or spent.

pitfalls: Must be an m_run signed by the governor key: Request has unexported fields and a closure, so no m_call can carry it.
Builder refusals panic and revert the whole tx (nothing recorded); refusals at apply time are recorded as spent.

actions.title: Execute a due decision
actions.description: Applies queued gno-side decision id once its delay has passed. Anyone may call it; a guardian hold defers it (except a seat change from day 21 of the hold), and a flag on the paying function defers sweeps and refund settlements.

params.name: id
params.validation: an existing pending decision whose due time has passed (Decision(id).Due <= now).
params.help: Decision number from the ledger (Decision event attr id, or render ibcgov:decisions).

timing.notes: Call when now >= due. A decision is re-checked against live state when it applies: a refusal SPENDS it (state spent, note says why); it is never retried.

pitfalls: Errors: 'decision N is due at T, not before'; 'is deferred: a guardian hold stands since T'; 'is <state>, not pending'.
A spent decision is final; build a new request if the state changes.

actions.title: Cancel a pending gno-side decision
actions.description: Withdraws a pending (queued) gno-side decision at once (ADR pr6375 §7.5: cancels are immediate). Guardians cannot cancel; only a decision can. A cancelled recovery expectation releases its intent.

params.name: id
params.validation: a decision that is pending now (and when the cancel is recorded).
params.help: Number of the decision to withdraw.

pitfalls: Only gno-side pending decisions. An Ethereum-bound decision is dispatched at once; cancel it on Ethereum with eth.cancel (kind 1).

actions.title: Activate a core implementation
actions.description: Activates a registered implementation of gno.land/r/aib/ibc/core after 7 days (ADR pr6375 §6.12).

params.name: path
params.validation: gno.land/r/aib/ibc/core/impl/v<N>, registered (core.RegisteredImplPaths()).

pitfalls: core.CheckUpdateImpl is re-run when it applies; a failing check spends the decision.

actions.title: Add a core relayer
actions.description: Adds an address to the core's relayer whitelist after 7 days. Only matters for non-Ethereum clients: relaying for an Ethereum client is permissionless.

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

actions.title: Remove a core relayer
actions.description: Removes a relayer from the whitelist: at once while others remain, after 7 days when it is the last one (an empty whitelist lets anyone relay).

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

timing.notes: Immediate if other relayers remain; queued (1 h testnet / 7 d mainnet) when it is the last one. Live: only one relayer, so queued.

actions.title: Recover a core client from a substitute
actions.description: Recovers a frozen or expired core client from a substitute client after 7 days (core recover-client.md).

params.name: subjectClientID
params.validation: a known core client (core.ClientType != "").

params.name: substituteClientID
params.validation: a known core client; the core's and light client's recovery checks run when it applies.

pitfalls: The builder only checks both ids exist; core.CheckRecoverClient runs at Execute and a failure spends the decision (e.g. subject == substitute, subject still Active).

actions.title: Approve a pending app registration
actions.description: Activates a pending IBC app registration on a port after 7 days.

params.name: portID
params.validation: a port with a pending registration (render gno.land/r/aib/ibc/core:apps/pending).

params.name: pkgPath
params.validation: the pending realm path for that port.

actions.title: Reject a pending app registration
actions.description: Drops a pending app registration at once.

params.name: portID
params.validation: a port with a pending registration.

params.name: pkgPath
params.validation: the pending realm path.

pitfalls: GovDAO can also do this directly, without the ibcgov ledger: govdao.core_reject_app_direct.

actions.title: Pause the core packet path
actions.description: Suspends the core's packet path (SendPacket, RecvPacket, acks, timeouts) at once. Reserved for a core bug: it blocks refunds too (ADR pr6375 §7.3).
pitfalls: A paused core also refuses governance packets: every Ethereum-bound decision recorded while paused is spent ('the core is paused').

actions.title: Unpause the core packet path
actions.description: Resumes the core packet path at once; spent under a guardian hold.
pitfalls: If the core is not paused the decision is recorded and SPENT (the tx still succeeds); check core.Paused() first.
Under a guardian hold (ibcgov.Held()) it is spent.

actions.title: Pause an IBC app
actions.description: Suspends the app on a port at once: its sends are refused and incoming packets get error acks.

params.name: portID
params.validation: a registered port (core.AppPkgPath(port) != ""): live ports transfer, gov.

pitfalls: Pausing port gov stops every Ethereum-bound decision (they are spent).

actions.title: Unpause an IBC app
actions.description: Resumes the app on a port at once; spent under a guardian hold, or when it is not paused.

params.name: portID
params.validation: a registered port.

pitfalls: Spent (tx succeeds) if the app is not paused (core.IsAppPaused).

actions.title: Add a core authority member
actions.description: Adds a member to the core authority (the tightening operations: pause, pause app, reject app) after 7 days.

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

actions.title: Remove a core authority member
actions.description: Removes a core authority member at once. The ibcgov realm itself cannot be removed.

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.
params.help: A current member (core.AuthorityMembers(); live: ibcgov g12l3du5z70zzq9rkc82asre09srefve7p5mfay4 and the GovDAO proxy g1p84dvfh4wrplyxx4zsmy77a8rxcnjup2j7zv5r).

pitfalls: Removing the GovDAO proxy removes GovDAO's direct pause path (govdao.core_pause_direct).

actions.title: Migrate a client's fork schedule
actions.description: Migrates the Ethereum fork schedule of a live core client after 7 days (ADR pr6375 R16, §6.12); must land before the fork epoch.

params.name: clientID
params.validation: an Ethereum core client.

params.name: paramsHex
params.validation: hex of ethereum.EncodeForkParameters; must decode (DecodeForkParameters refuses trailing bytes); the light client's CheckForkParameters runs at Execute.
params.help: Encoded fork schedule. The decision text spells it out fork by fork.

actions.title: Convert a client's verifier version
actions.description: Converts the verifier of a live Ethereum client to another verifier version after 7 days, with the conversion the active core implementation compiles in; the client keeps its id and state, its trust generation advances and its route's meters empty.

params.name: clientID
params.validation: an Ethereum core client (live verifier: core.VerifierVersion("ethereum-1") = ethereum/v0).

params.name: toVersion
params.validation: non-empty verifier version the active core impl can convert to.

pitfalls: Spent at Execute if the active core implementation declares no such conversion or the client is Frozen; install the core implementation first (core.update_impl).

actions.title: Activate a transfer implementation
actions.description: Activates a registered transfer implementation after 7 days.

params.name: path
params.validation: gno.land/r/aib/ibc/apps/transfer/impl/v<N>, registered (transfer.RegisteredImplPaths(); live only impl/v1, which is active).

pitfalls: transfer.CheckUpdateImpl runs at Execute (controls continuity, version acceptance); refusal spends it.

actions.title: Block an address in the transfer app
actions.description: Blocks an address at once: it can no longer send, and packets to it are refused (refunds already owed still go through).

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

pitfalls: GovDAO can also block directly (govdao.transfer_block_direct).

actions.title: Unblock an address
actions.description: Removes an address from the transfer blocklist after 7 days.

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

actions.title: Add a transfer authority member
actions.description: Adds a member to the transfer app's authority after 7 days.

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

actions.title: Remove a transfer authority member
actions.description: Removes a member of the transfer authority at once; the ibcgov realm stays.

params.name: addr
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

actions.title: Set gno guardian / watch-key seats
actions.description: Changes seats 0-3 (guardians) and 4-5 (watch keys) of ibcgov on gno.land. Every change, a vacancy included, waits 7 days and lands through a guardian hold no sooner than day 21 of it.

params.name: changes
params.validation: comma-separated seat:address, 1 to 6 items; seat 0-5, each once; empty address vacates; at most two guardian seats (0-3) per decision; no address in two seats; an address may not be set into the seat it already holds.

timing.notes: Through a hold: lands from day 21 of the hold that first deferred it (3 h on testnet). The first deferred Execute succeeds and only records the anchor.

pitfalls: These are the gno.land seats. Ethereum's IBCAdmin seats are eth.seats (kind 3), separate keys.
A vacancy only removes the exact tenure it was requested against; if the seat changed hands since, it is skipped.

actions.title: Set a flag (pause a route function)
actions.description: A seat flags one function of a route (sends, credits, payouts, refunds), pausing it at once. Two guardian seats flagging make a hold: every queued decision is deferred and every unpause is spent. A guardian's payouts flag may name suspect packets, which makes their void immediate.

params.name: route
params.validation: an enrolled route or any Ethereum core client (gno id, e.g. ethereum-1); router ids like client-0 are refused.

params.name: fn
params.validation: one of sends, credits, payouts, refunds.

params.name: keys
params.validation: "" or comma-separated packet keys (max 64); only for fn=payouts AND a guardian seat (0-3).

pitfalls: Caller must be the seat's key itself (cur.Previous() address) - a direct m_call from the seat address, or an m_run by it.
Re-asserting replaces the packet list.
Flags never stop voucher returns (burns), acks or timeouts.
The Ethereum guardian flag is IBCAdmin.setFlag() on Ethereum, outside Adena.

actions.title: Clear own flag
actions.description: A seat clears its own flag on a function of a route. Clearing a payouts flag starts the route's meters empty (new payouts epoch). A hold ends 24 h (514 s testnet) after fewer than two guardian seats flag.

params.name: route
params.validation: the route the flag stands on.

params.name: fn
params.validation: sends|credits|payouts|refunds; must be a live flag of the caller's seat (Flags(route) lines 'fn seat N at T').

pitfalls: Only your own seat's flag; to clear every seat's flags use route.unpause (a decision).
A route with unrestored losses stays closed whatever the flags.

actions.title: Prune stale flags
actions.description: Removes up to n flag entries of seats whose key left (storage reclaim only). Anyone.

actions.title: Unpause route functions (clear every seat's flags)
actions.description: Clears every seat's flags of the named functions on a route, at once (on gno.land GovDAO unpauses immediately). Spent under a guardian hold.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: fns
params.validation: comma-separated subset of sends,credits,payouts,refunds; non-empty.

pitfalls: Spent if no flag stood ('no flag stood') or a hold stands; the tx still succeeds.

actions.title: Enrol the Ethereum route
actions.description: Makes an Ethereum client a controlled route of the transfer app after 7 days, with its fee collector and protected bridge contracts; records the route identity. One route only, ever.

params.name: clientID
params.validation: Active Ethereum core client with counterparty registered, not retired, no route's client; and no route enrolled yet.

params.name: feeCollector
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.
params.help: Fee collector; not a bridge realm.

params.name: bridge
params.validation: "<router> <ics20> <ibcAdmin>": three distinct non-zero Ethereum addresses, SPACE separated; router must be the router the client reads.

pitfalls: Already done on the testnet (decision #1). A second enrolment is refused: one governance channel serves one route.

actions.title: Bind the governance channel
actions.description: Opens governance epoch 1 over the enrolled route's original client after 7 days. Once only.

params.name: clientID
params.validation: the enrolled route's original, Active client; channel not bound yet.

pitfalls: Done on the testnet (decision #5; epoch 1 over ethereum-1).

actions.title: Set denom / limits / fees on the route
actions.description: Enables a denom on the route or changes its caps, fees, send limits, refund cap, Ethereum token and voucher decimals. A pure tightening applies at once; a new denom or any loosening waits 7 days.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: denom
params.validation: unescrow: ugnot or a GRC20 alias (not ibc/); mint: the voucher's ibc/<hash>, or the token's 0x address (converted to ibc/sha256(transfer/<route>/<lower addr>)).

params.name: kind
params.validation: "unescrow" (gno-native) or "mint" (Ethereum token); never changes for an existing denom.

params.name: capFloor
params.validation: > 0; >= 4*fee; and never below the denom's launch_cap_floor (checked at apply: violating it SPENDS the decision).

params.name: supplyCap
params.validation: mint: > 0; unescrow: 0.

params.name: fee
params.validation: >= feeFloor, <= capFloor/4.

params.name: feeFloor
params.validation: > 0; changing it in either direction is a loosening (7 days).

params.name: sendMax
params.validation: unescrow: >= sendMin; mint: 0.

params.name: sendMin
params.validation: unescrow: > 0; mint: 0.

params.name: remoteToken
params.validation: unescrow: the token's GnoVoucher on Ethereum, non-zero 0x address (lower-cased); mint: "".

params.name: decimals
params.validation: mint: 0..18 and equal to the existing voucher's decimals once it exists; unescrow: 0.

timing.notes: Decided when recorded: controls.Loosens(old,new) -> queued; else at once. Loosening = higher capFloor/supplyCap/fee/sendMax/refundCap, lower sendMin, any change of feeFloor, remoteToken or decimals, or a new denom.

pitfalls: Live mint denom ibc/F7F044B527F1D7A9301210CB2F71A567B4FEA33C96B2CA56CB7D443AA3984D0C (token 0xbb30a5eec397174d5da58c4d180459da51114988, decimals 18).
Lowering capFloor below launch_cap_floor (render transfer:routes/ethereum-1) passes the builder but is spent: 'the cap floor ... cannot go below its launch value'.
A tightening with unchanged values is recorded as applied with no effect.
Ethereum-side limits of the same token are separate: eth.limits (kind 4).

actions.title: Set the route's fee collector
actions.description: Replaces a route's fee collector after 7 days.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: feeCollector
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.
params.help: New fee collector; not a realm of the bridge (core, transfer, ibcgov, ethrelay, any registered impl).

actions.title: Refuse send recipients
actions.description: Adds Ethereum addresses to the route's refused send recipients, at once.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: addrs
params.validation: comma-separated Ethereum addresses, 1 to 64.

actions.title: Stop refusing send recipients
actions.description: Removes refused send recipients after 7 days. The protected bridge contracts and voucher tokens stay refused whatever it names.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: addrs
params.validation: comma-separated Ethereum addresses, 1 to 64.

actions.title: Void claims / sweep entries
actions.description: Voids claims or sweep entries by packet key: forged drops remainders and books paid amounts as lost; withheld keeps them restorable. At once when a guardian's standing payouts flag names every packet, else after 7 days. Never refunds the source.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: keys
params.validation: comma-separated packet keys "<gnoClientId>/<sequence zero-padded to 20 digits>" (controls.PacketKey), 1 to 64.

params.name: forged
params.validation: true or false (Gno literal).

params.name: incident
params.validation: 1 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-' (no free text).
params.help: Incident label recorded with the decision.

timing.notes: Immediate if NamedSuspect(route,key) for every key when recorded (guardian payouts flag naming them); otherwise queued.

pitfalls: Every key must be voidable that way now (Voidable); none exist live.

actions.title: Restore withheld claims
actions.description: Restores withheld claims after 7 days (a restoration loosens; a hold defers it). Forged voids and voided sweep entries are final.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: keys
params.validation: comma-separated packet keys "<gnoClientId>/<sequence zero-padded to 20 digits>" (controls.PacketKey), 1 to 64.

actions.title: Credit a packet by vote
actions.description: Credits a received packet with a success ack by vote, for its whole payable amount, after 7 days; deduplicated against every claim of the packet.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: key
params.validation: one packet key "<gnoClientId>/<20-digit sequence>".

params.name: denom
params.validation: 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits and /:._- (ibcgov.isDenom).
params.help: Denom: ugnot, a GRC20 alias, or a voucher ibc/<hash>.

params.name: to
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

params.name: amount
params.validation: decimal digits, > 0, below 2^256 (written as a Gno integer literal in the run script).

pitfalls: Only grammar is checked when built; transfer re-checks the packet at Execute and spends the decision on failure.

actions.title: Pay sweep entries
actions.description: Pays sweep entries of one denom to an address after 7 days; deferred while the route's payouts are flagged.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: keys
params.validation: comma-separated packet keys "<gnoClientId>/<sequence zero-padded to 20 digits>" (controls.PacketKey), 1 to 64.

params.name: to
params.validation: bech32 g1... address; canonicalised to lower case (transfer.CanonicalAddress); refused if not an address.

pitfalls: Execute panics 'deferred: the payouts of route ... are flagged' while a payouts flag stands.

actions.title: Record a loss
actions.description: Records a loss a reconciliation recognised, after 7 days: chain gno or ethereum, cause forged-delivery or collision. One loss per packet.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: key
params.validation: one packet key "<gnoClientId>/<20-digit sequence>".

params.name: denom
params.validation: 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits and /:._- (ibcgov.isDenom).
params.help: Denom: ugnot, a GRC20 alias, or a voucher ibc/<hash>.

params.name: amount
params.validation: decimal digits, > 0, below 2^256 (written as a Gno integer literal in the run script).

params.name: chain
params.validation: gno or ethereum.

params.name: incident
params.validation: 1 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-' (no free text).
params.help: Incident label recorded with the decision.

params.name: cause
params.validation: forged-delivery or collision.

actions.title: Authorize a recapitalization
actions.description: Authorizes a recapitalization of the route's escrow of a denom after 7 days; anyone then pays it with transfer.Recapitalize.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: denom
params.validation: 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits and /:._- (ibcgov.isDenom).
params.help: Denom: ugnot, a GRC20 alias, or a voucher ibc/<hash>.

params.name: amount
params.validation: decimal digits, > 0, below 2^256 (written as a Gno integer literal in the run script).
params.help: Amount; for a coin denom at most 9223372036854775807.

params.name: incident
params.validation: 1 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-' (no free text).
params.help: Incident label recorded with the decision.

actions.title: Revoke a recapitalization authorization
actions.description: Revokes an unpaid recapitalization authorization at once.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: id
params.validation: an unpaid, unrevoked recapitalization id of the route.

actions.title: Reduce a liability
actions.description: Cuts an open or withheld claim, or an unpaid owed sweep entry, by an amount against an incident after 7 days (refunds are never reduced).

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: key
params.validation: one packet key "<gnoClientId>/<20-digit sequence>".

params.name: amount
params.validation: decimal digits, > 0, below 2^256 (written as a Gno integer literal in the run script).

params.name: incident
params.validation: 1 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-' (no free text).
params.help: Incident label recorded with the decision.

actions.title: Accept a deficit
actions.description: Records an accepted deficit after 7 days: the route reopens with that amount of its losses unrecovered.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: denom
params.validation: 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits and /:._- (ibcgov.isDenom).
params.help: Denom: ugnot, a GRC20 alias, or a voucher ibc/<hash>.

params.name: amount
params.validation: decimal digits, > 0, below 2^256 (written as a Gno integer literal in the run script).

params.name: incident
params.validation: 1 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-' (no free text).
params.help: Incident label recorded with the decision.

actions.title: Settle retired-client sends (gno side)
actions.description: Applies a reconciliation's outcomes to the sends of a client a replacement retired, after 7 days (gno analogue of Ethereum kind 12).

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: client
params.validation: a gno client a replacement retired from this route (Reader.RetiredRouteOf(client) == route; render transfer:routes 'replaced').

params.name: items
params.validation: comma-separated seq:action:amount, 1 to 64; seq > 0; action 1 genuine refund (amount = remaining entitlement, 0 if paid in full), 2 reject queued refund (0), 3 delivered (0), 4 forged refund (amount = paid, > 0), 5 forged receive (inbound seq; amount > 0); a sequence once per direction; actions 1-4 must match transfer.ProveOutcome.

params.name: incident
params.validation: 1 to 32 characters of a-z, 0-9 and '-' (no free text).
params.help: Incident label recorded with the decision.

pitfalls: Needs a prior route.replace and proven outcomes (transfer.ProveOutcome, run by a relayer tool).
Deferred while refunds are held (refunds flag) for items paying refunds.

actions.title: Replace the route's client (gno side)
actions.description: Re-points the route to a new Ethereum client after 7 days; the old client is retired (for transfers only while the governance epoch may still pass through it); the route closes until settlements and a reopen.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: newClientID
params.validation: Active Ethereum core client, counterparty registered, not retired, no route's client, authenticating the route identity (core.ClientRouteIdentity == ibcgov.RouteIdentity(route)); channel must be bound.

params.name: suspectFrom
params.validation: 0 <= h <= current gno.land height.

actions.description: Pays up to n queued refunds of a denom under the refund meter. Anyone.

params.name: clientID
params.validation: route's gno client.

params.name: denom
params.validation: 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits and /:._- (ibcgov.isDenom).
params.help: Denom: ugnot, a GRC20 alias, or a voucher ibc/<hash>.

params.name: n
params.validation: >= 1, clamped to 20.

pitfalls: Pays nothing under a refunds hold or on a closed route.

actions.title: Pay a recapitalization
actions.description: Pays an authorized recapitalization into the route's escrow. Coin denom: direct m_call sending exactly the amount; GRC20: approve the transfer realm first.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

params.name: id
params.validation: an authorized, unpaid recap id.

pitfalls: Must be a direct m_call (IsUserCall) for coins: an m_run does not pass the send.

actions.title: Continue a reopening
actions.description: Runs the next batch of a route's reopening started by a reopen decision. Anyone.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

actions.title: Prepare a replacement
actions.description: Walks up to n send records of retired clients and reserves refunds they may owe; required before settlements, sweeps, credits or a reopen apply. Anyone.

params.name: route
params.validation: a route key or one of its gno clients (current or retired); the route must be enrolled (ibcgov.IsRoute). The gno-side id, never the router's client-N.
params.help: The gno.land Ethereum route, named by its gno client id.

actions.title: Create a GovDAO proposal carrying an ibcgov request
actions.description: A GovDAO member wraps any ibcgov builder's Request in a proposal: dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), req.Proposal()). The builder's checks run at creation; the decision is recorded when the proposal executes.

params.name: EXPR
params.validation: an ibcgov builder call from this catalog.

timing.notes: Creating does nothing to ibcgov. The proposal must be EXECUTED within the 14-day deadline counted from creation (testnet: 7200 s = 2 h!), else the closure returns an error and GovDAO denies it for good.

pitfalls: Before the yield, creation works but execution panics ('a GovDAO proposal is refused until the yield'); the proposal stays executable for a retry after the yield, within its deadline.
Proposal id: ProposalCreated event attr id (or the println).
Title is 'gno.land/r/aib/ibc/ibcgov: <kind>', description the decision text.

actions.title: Vote on a GovDAO proposal
actions.description: A member votes YES/NO/ABSTAIN once per proposal. Supermajority 66.66% of current total power: with 3 T1 members (power 3 each) 2 YES are needed.

params.name: pid
params.validation: existing proposal id (render gno.land/r/gov/dao:).

params.name: option
params.validation: YES, NO or ABSTAIN.

actions.title: Execute a GovDAO proposal
actions.description: Anyone executes an accepted proposal; this runs the ibcgov closure, which records the decision (at once or queued).

params.name: pid
params.validation: a proposal that reached supermajority.

timing.notes: Then, for a queued decision, ibcgov Execute after the delay.

pitfalls: Panics (proposal stays open) if not yet at supermajority, or before the yield for an ibcgov request.
ExecuteOrRejectProposal marks it denied instead of panicking when the executor errors.

actions.title: GovDAO direct: pause the core
actions.description: Pauses the core packet path directly through the core authority (no ibcgov ledger, works before the yield). Tightening only; the matching loosening is an ibcgov decision.

timing.notes: Applies when the proposal executes (2 of 3 YES, then ExecuteProposal). No 14-day closure deadline here.

pitfalls: Requires the GovDAO proxy to stay a core/transfer authority member (core.AuthorityMembers()).

actions.title: GovDAO direct: pause an app
actions.description: Pauses an app directly through the core authority. Tightening only; the matching loosening is an ibcgov decision.

timing.notes: Applies when the proposal executes (2 of 3 YES, then ExecuteProposal). No 14-day closure deadline here.

pitfalls: Requires the GovDAO proxy to stay a core/transfer authority member (core.AuthorityMembers()).

actions.title: GovDAO direct: reject a pending app
actions.description: Drops a pending registration directly. Tightening only; the matching loosening is an ibcgov decision.

timing.notes: Applies when the proposal executes (2 of 3 YES, then ExecuteProposal). No 14-day closure deadline here.

pitfalls: Requires the GovDAO proxy to stay a core/transfer authority member (core.AuthorityMembers()).

actions.title: GovDAO direct: block an address
actions.description: Blocks an address in the transfer app directly. Tightening only; the matching loosening is an ibcgov decision.

timing.notes: Applies when the proposal executes (2 of 3 YES, then ExecuteProposal). No 14-day closure deadline here.

pitfalls: Requires the GovDAO proxy to stay a core/transfer authority member (core.AuthorityMembers()).
